def clean(df):
    import pandas as pd
    
    # Remove exact duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix species label variants (normalize case)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    
    # Fix island label variants (typos)
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'})
    
    # Convert numeric columns that might be strings
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Handle negative flipper_length_mm values (out of valid range 170-235)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    island_counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return island_counts
